sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)

Commencing Alpha Route. Welfare check at Starbucks; moved along a male individual sitting in front of the door entrance — he was compliant with our request and moved along without any issues. Patrolling along Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Arrived at the corner intersection of Queen Street and Wyndham Street; area thoroughly checked.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street; area scoped out thoroughly, all clear.
Arrived at Imperial Lane; floor checks completed with no issues identified.

Welfare check inside McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough around the area ensuring no issues are present, with welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and the vape shop, all clear.
Standing by at TK Square to maintain a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Arrived at the corner of Customs Street and Albert Street check-in, all clear.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Arrived at Federal Square; welfare check around the Cathedral Church, all clear.
Welfare check at Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Bakery, all clear.
Welfare check at Little Albert's Coffee, The People's Barista, Formery, Sergeant Coffee and Skymart Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at the Top of Victoria Street check-in; remaining stationed here until further notice or response calls.
Continuing patrols; no visible concerns requiring our services.

Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full walkthrough around the area completed, no problems or vagrants found. Standing by for response calls while maintaining a visible security presence. Ending Alpha Route.
Arrived at the Top of Mayoral Drive check-in; area scoped out, all clear.
Welfare check at the Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street check-in, all clear.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Arrived at the Elliott Street Apartments check-in; welfare check within Atrium on Elliott and the food court, all clear.
Commencing welfare checks on stores along Elliott Street while maintaining a strong security presence in the area.
Arrived at the Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street check-in, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Victoria Street intersection; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Arrived at High Street; commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses within the lane.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and the Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall, no issues found.
Arrived at the Chancery Square check-in; full sweep completed within the vicinity, no issues visible. Standing by to show presence while awaiting response calls.
Arrived at the Wilson Carpark Fort Street check-in; welfare check on all stores and the static guard present.
Arrived at the Bottom of Fort Street check-in; welfare checks commenced on all stores within the location, all clear. Standing by for response calls while showing presence.
Arrived at the Kiwibank check-in; full check-in on nearby stores, all clear. Ending Delta Route.
Patrolling along Commerce Street; checked in again at 77 Convenience Store and the vape store, all clear.
Welfare check at Kiwi Souvenirs, Quay Street, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough completed around the area, ensuring a strong security presence while awaiting further response calls.
Welfare check inside Woolworths Metro and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Customs Street and Albert Street check-in, all clear.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear. Patrolling up Albert Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street and Wyndham Street; checked in at Hollywood Bakery and Good To Go Supermarket, all clear.
Arrived at the Top of Victoria Street check-in. Roma Blooms reported a group of street vagrants sitting on the public benches, requesting we move them along.

Had a word with the group of individuals and saw an open bottle of alcohol, which gave us grounds to ask them to vacate the area or put the beverage away. They chose to leave the area without any further escalation. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Welfare check at the train station on Victoria Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Woolworths Victoria Street, all clear.
Patrolling along Elliott Street and Darby Street ensuring no vagrants are obstructing businesses or causing any issues, all clear.

A person of interest known as Junior was sitting in front of Ippondo; asked him to vacate the area due to complaints raised by the store about individuals sitting in front of their glass window. He complied and moved along without further escalation.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wellesley Street; conducting welfare checks back down towards HQ. Welfare check, all clear:
During the welfare sweep, the Cotton On manager waved the team down to move along an individual sitting in front of their store; the person was successfully moved along.
Arrived at HQ; standing by for lunch break and awaiting any response calls while preparing for changeover.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Second guard has arrived; gearing up for patrols.
Arrived at the Bottom of Durham Street East; welfare check on stores within the area complete, no issues reported from any of the stores.
Arrived outside Hallensteins Queen Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, no issues reported. Standing by for any nearby response calls.
While on standby, security from JB Hi-Fi pointed out a male who had just walked out of their store having stolen one of their items.
Items retrieved and returned to JB Hi-Fi; continuing standby for any nearby response calls.
Departing standby area; no issues occurred.
Arrived at the bottom of Vulcan Lane; welfare check on stores within the area and Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues reported. Standing by for security presence.
Departing standby area with nothing to report.
Arrived at the Pocket Park check-in; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, no issues reported.

Qs Convenience Store reported a male vagrant who is always sitting outside their other 77 Convenience branch on the corner of Victoria Street West and Hobson Street, smoking cannabis; the store manager asked if we could call in to that store to speak to him. Advised the manager we would call in while on patrols.
Arrived at the TK Square check-in, all clear, no issues; surrounding businesses also have nothing to report.
Arrived at the Albert Mart check-in, all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at the St Patrick's Square check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the Federal Street check-in, all clear, no issues.

Arrived at the Top of Victoria Street West check-in, all clear, no issues. Also checked in at the 77 Convenience branch on the corner of Victoria Street West and Hobson Street — the male the store manager reported has departed the area. Standing by in case he returns.
Leaving standby area; no issues and no sign of the vagrant from the 77 Convenience branch.
Arrived at the Wellesley Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the Elliott Street check-in, all clear, nothing to report. Standing by for security presence.

Response call from Lovisa Queen Street regarding a male and female couple who stole jewellery from their store, last seen heading down towards TK Square. Description — male: grey jumper and grey sweatpants with a butterfly logo on the back; female: brown track pants. Departing standby area and heading down to TK Square along Queen Street.
Arrived at TK Square; no sign of the male and female persons of interest from Lovisa.
Response message from Romani's Cafe regarding two male individuals, already trespassed from their premises, who entered the store again and caused a disturbance. (Photo on file.)
Arrived at Romani's Cafe; the two males had already left the premises. Standing by in case they return.
No sign of the two males; departing standby. Advised the store manager we will have a chat with them if found while on patrols.
Arrived at Lovisa to receive photos or footage of the persons of interest who stole earlier; standing by.
Staff do not have access to the cameras, so no photos or footage were received; they advised they will send it tomorrow. Maintaining our presence on Queen Street.
Floor checks completed; commencing a 10-minute break before patrolling.
Arrived at the Top of Victoria Street West; welfare check on stores complete, no issues reported. Standing by for any problematic issues that may occur within the area.
Departing standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at the Wyndham Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the St Patrick's Square check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the Albert Mart check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the Lower Albert Street check-in, all clear, no issues reported, including the surrounding stores.
Arrived at the Reign & Pour check-in; no issues reported.
Arrived at the TK Square check-in, nothing to report; welfare check on stores, all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at the Gore Street check-in; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, no issues.
Response call from The Queens Ferry regarding a male individual harassing their customers; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane; a staff member identified the individual responsible for the harassment. Currently dealing with the male individual; standing by.
The male has been successfully moved along; standing by in case he decides to return.
Arrived at Chancery Square; welfare check, all clear, nothing to report.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street and Victoria Street West.
Arrived at the Auckland Library; welfare check, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the Munster Inn check-in; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, no issues.
Arrived outside McDonald's Queen Street; welfare check, all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at the Darby Street check-in, all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Bar 101, which is open; standing by for security presence and as backup for the on-site guards if needed.
Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone (percentage displayed on the kitchen camera).

On standby at HQ, sheltering from heavy rain.
On standby outside Bar 101 showing security presence.
Elliott Street, Darby Street and Wilson Carpark all clear, no issues to report.

Check-in at Shortland Street, all clear, no issues.
Queen Street full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Commercial Bay; commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report.
Quay Street full sweep complete, all clear, no issues.

All clear at Providor, no issues to report.

Crowd at Providor; on standby showing presence.
All clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, no issues to report.
Patrolling Customs Street, all clear, no issues.
Check-in at Gore Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Fort Street; welfare checks conducted at Tribe and Jo & Joes, no issues to report. Wilson Carpark all clear, no issues to report.
On standby at Imperial Lane for any nearby calls.
All clear at Imperial Lane; patrolling up High Street.
Shortland Street all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in at Freyberg Square and Chancery Square, all clear, no issues to report; on standby showing presence.
All clear at Chancery Square, no issues to report.
Welfare check at the Metropolis Hotel, all clear, no issues to report.
Kitchener Street all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling Wellesley Street.
Check-in at the corner of Lorne Street, Wakefield Street and the Library, all clear, no issues.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ for a 30-minute break.
Break ended; on standby at HQ charging the Ops Phone (low percentage) while remaining vigilant for any response calls.
